answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36592 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Dream regarding Imam Ghazali Rahmahullah. Question: I once dreamt of Imam Ghazali (RA). He was fair and strong. He had long white shoulder-length hair and long beard. His clothes were dark orange in colour, orange turban and orange kurta, vest and lungi. He was giving khutba. I was looking at him in the face. He looked very serious. Please interpret. Answer ID: 36592 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 314/174/H=1433) In-shaAllah you shall gain from the knowledge of Imam Ghazali (رحمة الله عليه). Study the Fazail Sadaqat of Hadhrat Shaikhul Hadith (رحمة الله عليه). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
